name: max_standby_streaming_delay
description: Maximum delay before canceling conflicting read-only queries on a hot standby when applying streamed WAL data.
symptoms: Excessive lag during high-write workloads on primary
Stale reads due to aggressive query cancellation
tuning_tips: Set to 0 to cancel conflicting queries immediately; set higher (e.g., 30000–60000) to tolerate brief lag and reduce cancellations; avoid indefinite (-1) in latency-sensitive read workloads. Always pair with hot_standby_feedback for better conflict avoidance.
